title: Implement Share API (POST/GET/DELETE /shares + MCP tools)
acceptance: POST /shares (share.create, quiz.read) returns {shareId,url,embedUrl,og} per spec §6.1
GET /shares/{id} public, applies §4.16 privacy rules, 404 on revoked
DELETE /shares/{id} (share.revoke, quiz.read) sets revoked_at — owner or admin only
Idempotency: Idempotency-Key header primary, natural-tuple dedup fallback per §6.1
MCP manifest exposes share.create/get/revoke tools per §7
notes: OG image generator deferred to §12 — v1 returns a stub or static placeholder.

title: Implement embed route + anonymous-attempt path
acceptance: GET /{kinds}/{id}/embed where kinds ∈ quizzes|exams|items returns iframe-friendly view
Route precedence: /quizzes/{id}/embed declared before /quizzes/{id} so longer path wins
?interactive=1 enables anonymous attempts, rate-limited per IP (suggested 30/10min)
Anonymous attempts written to anonymous_attempts only, never to a user's record
429 anonymous_attempt_rate_limited on overflow
notes: Spec §6.1 + §5.2. Rate limit may live in Tower middleware.
